# ObjRun (Object Run)

> An objective runtime for AI agents and scientific research.

Criteria are sealed before a run. Agents submit candidates, receive declared feedback, and retry within a budget. Every verdict is recorded.

## Primary sources and data

- [Source code and setup](https://github.com/objrun-team/objrun)
- [Runtime protocol](https://github.com/objrun-team/objrun/blob/main/docs/loop.md)
- [Research paper](https://objrun-team.github.io/paper.pdf)
- [Benchmark results and provenance (JSON)](https://objrun-team.github.io/benchmark-results.json)
- [Replay verdicts and reachability data (JSON)](https://objrun-team.github.io/data/runs.json)

U is a single-attempt baseline. F includes objective checks and retries within benchmark-specific budgets; it is not a compute-matched comparison. DeepSWE, Terminal-Bench and SkillsBench have external U references rather than paired local baselines.
